g.text: B J DESAI • COMPLETE SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & DATA FLOW ENGINE
Real-time Multi-Location ERP • 2-Tier Capital Pool • Central Material Stock • 7-Category Tab Flow & Financial Formulas
Available Capital = Total Contributions - Total Upad
- Total Location Allocations - Central Material Purchases
Allocated from Admin to Specific Project (investor_location_allocations)
Capital drawn into active project operations (investment_transactions)
Category 1 Balance = Allocated Capital - Investment Transfers
Category 2 Balance = Inflow - All 5 Site Cost Deductions
(Customer Supply + Site Supply + Labour Attendance + Kharch + Contractor)
Bulk Material Purchases do NOT deduct from Location balance.
Purchases record which site/location received or initiated goods.
Stock IN = Material Purchases (funded by Admin)
Stock OUT = Customer Supplies + Site Supplies
Current Balance = Total IN - Total OUT (Stock Ledger)
Available Admin Capital = Total Inflow - Total Outflow
• Pre-validation Check: Before recording any Material
Purchase or Location Allocation, system checks if:
• Prevents deficit spending across the entire enterprise.
• Real-time broadcast sync across all connected screens.
